summary: Reina Tello's San Francisco school board platform addresses only local education issues—culturally connected curricula, Spanish-language family access, and community school funding—with no mention of Palestine or Israel in her stated positions. CAIR Action, whose recommendations weigh Gaza and ceasefire positions, endorsed her in the general election. That endorsement is the only directional evidence in the record, and a candidate with organizational support but no personal statement or action on Palestinian justice reaches no further than this level.
